details:
WebKitGTK is the port of the portable web rendering engine WebKit to the GTK platform.

Security Fix(es):

* chromium-browser: angle: Use after free in ANGLE (CVE-2026-95325)

* chromium-browser: angle: Out of bounds write in ANGLE (CVE-2026-95331)

* chromium-browser: angle: Out of bounds read in ANGLE (CVE-2026-106304)

* chromium-browser: angle: Buffer overflow in ANGLE (CVE-2026-106247)

* chromium-browser: angle: Type confusion in ANGLE (CVE-2026-106293)

* chromium-browser: angle: Uninitialized resource in ANGLE (CVE-2026-106245)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
